function.description: Update your published ERC-8004 registration file (setAgentURI). Use this when your endpoints, description or avatar change — it does NOT mint a new identity. dry_run defaults to TRUE.
function.name: defi_trade_set_agent_uri

chain.description: Chain to update the agent URI on — CHOOSE IT DELIBERATELY, because the same address is a different token on a different chain. Chains that can move value: ethereum, base, robinhood, arbitrum, polygon. Gas and per-chain guidance: the `chain` parameter of defi_trade.swap.

why.description: Why this act, now (one line). Required on an autonomous run; the owner reads it.
